:::{#def-conditional-prob}
#### Conditional probability

For two events $A$ and $B$ with $\Pr(B) > 0$,
the **conditional probability** of $A$ given $B$,
denoted $\Pr(A \mid B)$, is:

$$\Pr(A \mid B) \eqdef \frac{\Pr(A \cap B)}{\Pr(B)}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-conditional-prob}
#### Rolling a six, given an even roll

For a fair die (@exm-probability),
let $A = \set{6}$ and $B = \set{2, 4, 6}$.
Then $A \cap B = \set{6}$, so:

$$
\ba
\Pr(A \mid B)
&= \frac{\Pr(A \cap B)}{\Pr(B)}
&& \text{(@def-conditional-prob)} \\
&= \frac{1/6}{3/6}
&& \text{(substitute the probabilities)} \\
&= \frac{1}{3}
&& \text{(simplify)}
\ea
$$

:::
